items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Leonard Hannon Davis, Jimmy Harris on trombone, Tommy Ladnier on trumpet.

ctx.x: -- Benny Carter and Jimmy Harris (or) trombone player, so we'd go down to the dance corner on East 14th Street. What happened, Say hey fellow (unintelligible) -- they got a guy in town, man, he was a hell of a trumpet player. Said, yeah? Yeah. Well, what does he play? Everything. Said, bring him on down. So the trick was they started off in the key of C, keep (unintelligible) on up. go through (Unintelligible) all the keys. If the fellow fall out, get in them big keys (unintelligible).
like the pianos chatters in E majors, you know, or like the B natural Jimmy said -- Benny said (unintelligible). I said, right, he's playing them keys, man. (Unintelligible) --
